scope: One read-only pg_catalog presence SELECT on documented linked Kopplas backend; no tenant data/secrets/DB/provider writes
query: SELECT pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.booking_series') IS NOT NULL AS booking_series_present, pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.time_reports') IS NOT NULL AS time_reports_present, pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.calendar_feed_tokens') IS NOT NULL AS calendar_feed_tokens_present, pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.read_my_day(uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean)') IS NOT NULL AS migration119_read_my_day_present;
concrete_impact: Required series/time/calendar-feed relations and exact My Day RPC are absent; deploying E15 against this backend breaks those paths (MyDay reader returns UNAVAILABLE).
minimal_remedy: Apply existing reviewed pending forward migrations in dependency order through119 under separate database-push authorization; do not invent replacement objects.
